pre.speaker: narrator
pre.text: A prison cart on the Guangzong road. Inside sits Lu Zhi, Liu Bei's old teacher, in chains: he would not bribe the court's envoy, so the envoy reported him for cowardice.

pre.speaker: pc-huo
pre.text: Stand aside. This is the court's business, and the court pays better than you do.

pre.speaker: zhang-fei
pre.text: Brother, say the word. I have been holding this spear for a mile.

pre.speaker: liu-bei
pre.text: If we do this, the court will call us outlaws. Do it anyway. Catch the cart before the county gate.

post.speaker: narrator
post.text: Captain Huo goes down in the road and his paid men throw down their halberds. Zhang Fei breaks the cart's lock with the butt of his spear.

post.speaker: liu-bei
post.text: Teacher. You are free, and we are outlaws. I think it was a fair trade.

post.speaker: narrator
post.text: Lu Zhi does not argue. He asks only that his veterans be told where to find him at Guangzong.
